files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
- Publish the accepted 0.3 feature set as the first stable Library release for Nextcloud 33–35.
- Retain RC3 functionality, including bounded title/description search on large catalogues.
- Update release identity, package signatures and public documentation; no database migration.


- Replace the first RC after removing private test evidence, local infrastructure references and real-catalogue imagery from the public Git history.
- Keep the database schema unchanged; use bounded indexed candidates for title/description search on large catalogues and update the release identity and browser asset names.
- Recheck the exact signed replacement before publishing it. The old RC must be withdrawn when the replacement is live.
- Exclude local Python virtual environments from release archives.


- Freeze the 0.3 catalogue, author/series/genre editor, metadata review, reading-list, and file-handling workflows for release-candidate certification.
- Show catalogue pages before exact totals and keep indexed sort orders responsive on large libraries, as introduced in alpha.42–43.
- Refresh release metadata and public screenshots for the first 0.3 App Store prerelease. No new schema migration beyond the migrations already shipped in the alpha series.
- Declare the existing reading-status sort column and index in the install schema, matching the alpha.40 migration on fresh SQLite, MariaDB and PostgreSQL installations.


- Page Publication date, Series, Recently opened and Format on indexed, narrow item rows before loading full metadata. A forward migration adds three composite sort indexes and a format sort value backfilled from file extensions.
- Keep the indexed format value current when scanning a file whose extension changed. Stable ID tie breakers make paging deterministic; date and recently opened ties now follow descending title order, while Series dates follow ascending order.
- Retain alpha.42's immediate sorting feedback and separate exact count.


- Show sorted catalogue pages before calculating the exact total. Next/Previous use a one-row lookahead, and a separate request fills in the count without blocking the visible results.
- Place a visible loading indicator beside Sort and catalogue status; retain results on request failure and offer Retry. Cache recent counts across sort changes and refresh after review updates.
- Render Home and Shelves before their aggregate summaries finish. Show root links and loading/retry feedback while counts and folder hierarchy load.
- Keep book-neighbor navigation working while a catalogue total is pending. No database migration.


- Restore the full catalogue row after narrow status-sort pagination. Nextcloud's query-builder clone shares its selected columns; alpha.40 returned sorted IDs but omitted book metadata in those rows. This also corrects metadata loss on later pages of other sorted views.
- Keep the indexed reading-status order and its measured large-catalogue response time.


- Materialize and index reading-status order, then page through narrow item IDs before loading metadata. The installed alpha.39 query took about 22 seconds for the existing catalogue books, compared with about 9 seconds for the existing title view. An additive migration backfills existing statuses.
- Update the cover-paste instructions and release verification record.


- Keep Review queue in place after applying a scanner suggestion, show the outcome and advance to the next pending suggestion. Show linked covers in the workbench and result rows.
- Make Reading status visible in the catalogue toolbar and add a stable reading-status sort with a stated order.
- Make the whole book cover a clipboard-paste target, with a file-picker fallback where clipboard image access is unavailable. Reduce the cover action overlays so more artwork remains visible.
- No database migration.


- Add ASIN and GGKEY identifiers, a 20-language starter picker, reordered catalogue filters and sorted Previous/Next book navigation.
- Improve path extraction with per-file Apply and Undo, subfolder and file-order controls, underscore replacement, a supplied Title - Author pattern, ISBN capture and inline placeholder help.
- Add a reversible To delete state for books on read-only mounts, while retaining confirmed source deletion where permissions allow.
- Fix title/description substring search on SQLite, reading-list availability labels and worklist history after Apply.
- Additive migrations support deletion markers and file-worklist ordering. Hosted CI passed 79 browser journeys; the signed package is deployed on developer NC34.


- Add a reversible To delete state and review queue for source files on read-only mounts.


- Assign saved, supplied or draft filename/path patterns per file in a bounded worklist. Bulk assignment includes only complete structural matches and selects empty fields only.
- Review fields from different patterns together, with per-file server parsing and atomic Apply/Undo. Keep pattern configuration collapsed during routine review.
- Update the extraction guide and human test case for mixed naming conventions. No database migration.
- Update the release build to Vite 7.3.7 after its security advisory.


- Group sidebar destinations into Library, Discover, Your lists and Review and cleanup.
- Use matching decorative icons, section labels, separators and a clear review disclosure arrow.
- Replace the dashed new-list callout with a quieter highlighted action.
- Apply the same navigation treatment to the language and publisher/subject review pages.
- Retain existing destinations, active states, keyboard behavior and pinned catalogue Settings. No database migration.


- Use readable theme foregrounds for errors and destructive controls.
- Keep profile search drafts separate from applied result and return contexts.
- Share catalogue filter keyboard selection and lookup feedback.
- Reserve mobile navigation clearance and align view switches and toolbars.
- Align Publication / periodical, Shelf and Covers terminology.
- Reuse the language picker in cleanup forms and align maintenance navigation.
- Normalize review typography, card context and directory framing.
- Verified with 77 packaged browser journeys; signed package deployed to developer NC34. No database migration.


- Align picker keyboard selection and explicit subject creation; fix initial ArrowUp navigation.
- Keep directory draft queries and applied searches clear across sorting and Back navigation.
- Restore catalogue/directory scroll position and focus after opening Details.
- Reduce catalogue controls, emphasize book identity and adapt preview width to book count.
- Share Author/Series book toolbars and cards; add server-side Series title search and sorting.
- Flatten narrow settings forms and distinguish Publication from Series suggestions.




- Restore Home covers and make cover/title links open the book editor consistently; retain an explicit Quick view action.
- Put catalogue search first, keep saved-search naming secondary, and preserve filters on sorting.
- Protect author, series and reading-list drafts; share Save/Discard controls and removal confirmations.
- Align remote suggestions with loading, retry, keyboard selection and creation only after a successful empty lookup.
- Share page typography, focus/touch styling, review comparisons and operation status; put shelf setup ahead of advanced settings.
- Show import errors in the maintenance shell with editable input and current/proposed values.
- No database migration. App Store certification and manual assistive-technology acceptance remain separate gates.


- Add confirmed source-file deletion from book Details, with shared-OPF retention and guarded empty-parent cleanup.
- Preserve Nextcloud trash handling, validate identities and revisions, and report partial cleanup outcomes. Remove catalogue/search/duplicate links after successful file deletion.
- Keep reading-list entries as unavailable, retain entity identities and restore the originating view after deletion. No schema migration.
- Compact final JavaScript whitespace after bundling, recovering frontend package headroom without increasing size limits.


- Authors directory: displayed-name A–Z by default, reverse-name and surname sorting, debounced three-letter search and restored return context.
- Shared Authors, Series and Genres browser, including paged genres.
- Compact directory rows with linked book counts and up to three lazy-loaded book-cover/title previews. Existing author typeahead remains lightweight.
- Additive `library_authors_display` ordering index; no author names or book metadata are rewritten.


- Resolve selective author-name candidates before catalogue joins, restoring fast content search without waiting for reindexing after author renames. Keep complete results for broad queries.
- Label the catalogue filter Author; accept partial names and surnames when no exact legacy/full-name match exists. Speed up canonical suggestions and include names occurring within display/sort names.
- Correct the language-filter SQL expression and add repeatable real-catalogue SQL/browser probes, isolated search/filter/bounds regressions and human testing steps. No database migration.


- Replace destination-author Search and select controls with a three-letter typeahead, direct keyboard/pointer selection and explicit creation after no matches.
- Cancel stale searches and invalidate the previous review when the destination changes. Keep reviewed confirmation and Undo. No database migration.


- Consolidate Authors, Series, conflict review and legacy bookmarks on one book editor, preserving Back context and redirect feedback.
- Show compact saved metadata status below Nextcloud interactions, before imported suggestions and file metadata. Use assigned authors for completeness once migration is ready.
- Omit the unused legacy editor bundle from release packages; retain compatible mutation endpoints. No database migration.
- Add browser entry-point and mobile disclosure journeys, and redirect/ownership/status runtime checks.
